target_customer: Developers building AI agents that need a safe local shell
problem: Agents need a safe bash environment, but VMs and remote sandboxes add overhead and infrastructure.
business_model: Developer infrastructure, open source runtime (bVisor); no revenue model found

founders.name: Erik Dunteman
previous_startups: Pig.dev (YC W25, Windows desktop agents, abandoned)
founders.background_notes: Education not found. Modal says researcher Raymond Tana also joined Modal; YC lists a team of 2 but names only Erik.

technical_complexity.rationale: bVisor is a virtual Linux kernel written from scratch in Zig per Modal, hard systems work for a two person team, though still a proof of concept.

defensibility.rationale: Novel runtime but early and Linux only; well funded sandbox vendors compete.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Modal acquired the team in April 2026.

market_need_then: AI agents running code needed isolation; comparison pages in 2026 show a crowded sandbox market, but no dated demand evidence from early 2025 was found.

brand_strength.rationale: Many unrelated companies are named Butter and the company reused the name across a pivot; no press about the brand found.

pivots.from: Pig, API to automate Windows desktops with AI agents
pivots.to: Muscle Mem, a cache for repeatable agent tasks (Butter)
pivots.why: Customers rejected both the API and developer tool versions and wanted finished automation projects, per TechCrunch.

pivots.from: LLM proxy and Muscle Mem cache
pivots.why: Not stated by a source; YC page and job posts show different descriptions.

outcome_analysis: Butter descended from Pig, whose Windows agent product found no demand, then moved through an agent cache to a Zig sandbox runtime. In April 2026 Modal announced Butter was joining it, with the founder and a researcher joining Modal's Sandbox team. Price was not disclosed and the product was an early proof of concept, so this reads as a team acquisition. The directory status Active is out of date.
notes: Directory status says Active but Modal announced the acquisition on 2026-04-10. No funding for this Butter found; CB Insights and others list unrelated Butter companies. No competitor sources dated near Winter 2025 were found. Whether the acquisition is an acquihire is not stated, so acquihire_soft_landing is not recorded.
